rollups.text: Books and audiobooks the user read, listened to, or considered: The Hating Game by Sally Thorne (finished in April 2023; loved it by 2023-05-21); Gone Girl by Gillian Flynn (listening on 2023-05-21 and enjoying its suspense); The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo by Taylor Jenkins Reid (read by 2023-05-21; loved it and praised Julia Whelan’s audiobook narration); The Silent Patient by Alex Michaelides (considering moving it higher on the reading list on 2023-05-21); The Rosie Project by Graeme Simsion and The Kiss Quotient by Helen Hoang (especially intrigued by both on 2023-05-21).

rollups.text: Musical instruments, artists, and songs the user engaged with: resumed guitar lessons after a 10-year hiatus and listened heavily to Bon Iver and Fleet Foxes (2023-06-09); wanted to learn Bon Iver’s “Skinny Love” and Fleet Foxes’ “White Winter Hymnal” (2023-06-09); began learning S. Carey’s “In the Dirt” and “Mothers” (2023-06-09); used a steel-string acoustic guitar and considered a nylon-string guitar for a warmer tone (2023-06-09); learned “Pride and Joy” by Stevie Ray Vaughan (2023-06-17); took guitar lessons with Alex for six weeks and reported significant improvement (2023-06-17); started learning ukulele online (2023-06-17); used a new guitar amplifier for two weeks and said it greatly improved their sound (2023-06-17).

The user’s gardening developed from growing basil and tomatoes into planning a garden party and adding companion plants. Basil sprouts appeared by the end of April 2023; by 2023-06-12 the plants were thriving, the user regularly harvested leaves to encourage growth, and used basil for pesto. By 2023-06-12 the user was harvesting tomatoes almost daily and observed that sunnier tomatoes tasted sweeter and had fewer blemishes; some plants were tall. The user noticed yellowing and wilting leaves, reduced watering, and thought the change helped; planned to prune and support the plants. On 2023-06-12 the user planned a garden party using garden tomatoes and basil, choosing bruschetta and tomato-basil skewers as appetizers and Caprese salad as the main course, and decided to add borage and oregano as companion plants.

The user’s commute changed from driving to taking the bus after starting a new job around March 2023, giving them more time for podcasts. The user usually took the 7:45 a.m. train at an earlier point, but on 2023-06-14 missed it by five minutes and paid $12 for a taxi. By 2023-06-17 the user liked the idea of leaving earlier to create a time buffer and planned to use the extra time for reading, aiming for at least 20 pages daily. The user also worked on the bus but sometimes struggled to focus: after a noisy passenger snored during the week of 2023-06-10 to 2023-06-16, the user switched seats. On 2023-06-17 the user planned to arrive earlier at the bus stop and seek a seat near the front, and liked trying Pomodoro sessions with the “Morning Boost” Spotify playlist.

The user’s career progressed from Marketing Specialist to Senior Marketing Manager at Smith & Co. Around 2023-02-23, manager Rachel hinted at growth opportunities; by 2023-05-23 the user had moved into the Senior Marketing Manager role and was glad they had taken Rachel’s advice to step up. The user reported a good start with the new team and wanted to build relationships across departments. The role included developing a marketing strategy with the sales team and attending executive meetings; the user planned a sales-team meeting, preparation time for executive meetings, and prioritization of critical tasks. On 2023-06-17 the user said the new role felt overwhelming and sought ways to support focus.

The user developed the Pig aircraft concept through successive requirements and estimates on 2023-06-17. The user specified six people total, including the pilot/engineer, and a fixed cabin height of 1.90 m; the user wanted enough height to stand inside. Assistant-provided rough dimensions and weight estimates changed repeatedly, including an estimate of 3,200 kg MTOW and another of 1,820 kg; the user challenged the 240 kg allowance for six people and baggage. The assistant acknowledged the error, recalculated 630 kg for six people at 75 kg each plus 40 kg baggage each, and then proposed a 1,600 kg total breakdown. The user chose a six-rotor configuration. By the latest discussion, the assistant said initial requirements and parameters were established, while component and material selection, aerodynamic and propulsion optimization, and control and navigation algorithms remained unresolved. Proposed next stages were engineering drawings, manufacturing and assembly, testing and certification, and later delivery and monitoring; possible Dubai operation by 2030 was described as uncertain. The elapsed span between recorded design steps was one day; no completed design or certification is established.
The user reported completing five books in the three months before 2023-05-21. The user also aimed to read at least 20 pages per day by 2023-06-17; no later completion count is recorded.

The user said on 2023-06-01 that they had taken two personal vacation flights during the preceding month. On 2023-06-17 the user reported returning from a week-long trip to Hawaii; the records do not establish whether that trip was one of those two flights.

The user’s exercise habits and plans varied across records: on 2023-05-19 the user chose to try 30-minute brisk walking, without adopting the suggested three-times-weekly frequency; by 2023-06-12 the user had gone to the gym during lunch on both Monday and Tuesday; the user also reported yoga about three times a week and regular strength training three times a week. For 2023-06-19 through 2023-06-25, the user accepted a plan for five morning sessions of 30–45 minutes, with yoga three days, jogging two days, strength training on three days, and weekends off. These are documented sessions, habits, and plans, not a verified count of workouts completed over time.

The user used or considered sustainable household and personal-care products: reusable cotton rounds had replaced disposable rounds by 2023-06-17; the user had been using EcoClean dish soap and was open to alternatives; the user was especially interested in Seventh Generation and Ecover laundry detergents. The user also sought eco-friendly makeup removers and gentle cleansers, but no specific recommended product was confirmed as purchased or adopted.

The user described a growing effort to reduce waste and environmental impact. By 2023-06-17, the user said they had been consciously reducing their carbon footprint for about three months and had already replaced disposable makeup-removal rounds with reusable cotton rounds, which they said made a noticeable difference. The user wanted to reduce waste in more aspects of life, was using EcoClean dish soap but open to alternatives, and was exploring sustainable laundry detergent and eco-friendly makeup products. No later outcome or product switch is recorded.
